tenderSchedule.title: Short term RFP for Selection of Agency to Provide 92 Software Engineers & IT Human Resources to Greater Bengaluru Authority
tenderSchedule.description: Short term RFP for Selection of Agency to Provide 92 Software Engineers & IT Human Resources to Greater Bengaluru Authority

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Office of Special Commissioner, Revenue and IT Section , Annexure 1 Building, GBA Head Office, NR Square, Bengaluru-560002

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have satisfactorily executed in the last 7 years a minimum of three (3) IT Professional or Software Developer supply or deployment projects for the Government of Karnataka, any other State Government, Government of India, or Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) owned by State or Central Government

The Bidder should have successfully executed at least two (2) projects each involving the deployment of a minimum of thirty (30) software developers for a continuous period of at least one (1) year to any State Government, Central Government, or Public Sector Undertaking (PSU) within the last seven (7) years.Each such project should have a total contract value of 5 Crores (INR Five Crores) or more

The Agency shall demonstrate experience in providing senior or specialized professionals for complex technology assignments involving areas such as software architecture, software development, cloud, DevOps, data engineering, AI/ML, cybersecurity, GIS, database engineering or other specialised technology functions relevant to GBA's requirements.
The Bidder should have annual turnover of at least INR 50 Crores in each of the last three financial years (2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Turnover from IT consultancy/ IT services / Software Engineers Supply should be minimum INR 25 Cr in each of the last three financial years (2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26. 2022-23 turnover is also accepted instead of the year 2025-26 if not available)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Board Resolution / Power of Attorney / Authorisation
Certificate of Incorporation / Registration Certificate
Consortium / Joint Venture bidding shall NOT be permitted
Declaration regarding Corrupt / Fraudulent Practices
ISO certifications ISO 27001/ISO 9001
The Agency shall be compliant with applicable EPF, ESI, GST, income-tax and labour laws applicable to its employees and operations
The Agency shall have an operational office in Karnataka for coordination and administration of the engagement
The Agency shall have at least 100 Software Engineers as its employees, each drawing annual remuneration of not less than 12,00,000/- as on the last date of submission of the bid in this tender
The Agency shall have at least 300 IT / technology professionals on its rolls as on the date specified in the Tender Schedule
The Agency shall have at least 500 employees on its rolls as on the date specified in the Tender Schedule
The Agency shall have been in operation for at least 10 years as on the date specified in the Tender Schedule
The Agency shall have established experience in software engineering, software development, IT/technology consulting, or provision and management of software and technology professionals
The Agency shall not be under insolvency, liquidation, winding-up or similar proceedings as on the bid submission date

The Agency shall not have been blacklisted, debarred or declared ineligible by any Central Government / State Government Department, Government authority, PSU or statutory body as on the bid submission date
The Agency shall not subcontract or outsource the core responsibility of sourcing, engaging and managing the software / technology professionals required under this RFP
The Agency shall possess a valid GST registration
The Agency shall possess a valid ISO 27001 and/or ISO 9001 certification
The Agency shall submit the prescribed undertaking relating to its Karnataka office
The Bidder should have SEI-CMMI Level 5 Certification or above
The person signing the bid shall be duly authorised
Undertaking regarding employment claims and litigation

itemList.itemName: The bidder shall quote the Service Charge in percentage (%), and the same shall remain fixed for the duration of the Contract, subject to the provisions of this RFP
